_readme: SAIRNlaw holiday calendars -- District of Columbia (Superior Court, Probate Division), 2026-2031.
Derived from D.C. Super. Ct. Prob. R. 128(a)(6)(A), which NAMES the eleven days, each on the day set aside by statute for observing it.
Gate: docs/2026-10-30-hank-b70-dc-probate-deadline-seed-gate.md (hank b70). DELIBERATELY ABSENT, EARLY: DC Emancipation Day, Inauguration Day, and any day observed under Rule 128(a)(6)(B).

authority.citation: D.C. Super. Ct. Prob. R. 128(a)(6)(A), with D.C. Code 28-2701 and 5 U.S.C. 6103(b) for the observed day
authority.note: The eleven days Rule 128(a)(6)(A) names, each on the day set aside by statute for observing it. NOT ENCODED, EARLY: DC Emancipation Day and Inauguration Day (D.C. Code 28-2701 holidays that Rule 128(a)(6)(A) does not name), and every day under Rule 128(a)(6)(B). See JURISDICTION_COVERAGE.dc.

dates.name: Independence Day (Saturday shift)
dates.derivation: Rule 128(a)(6)(A) "the day set aside by statute for observing": Independence Day falls on Saturday 2026-07-04, and D.C. Code 28-2701 / 5 U.S.C. 6103(b) set aside the Friday before

dates.name: Columbus Day
dates.derivation: Rule 128(a)(6)(A), second Monday in October (D.C. Code 28-2701 names the same day Indigenous Peoples' Day) 2026-10-12
